description: Approved recap steps 2-4: HistoryIngress owns durable confirmation and association, TranscriptHistory owns placement. Canonical messages stored once, fixed target references, atomic enqueue with IDs only, existing worker thin adapter. Reuse owner for PR B .8/.28, no competing retry state machine or full-message confirmation store. Tests first: immutable audience/identity targets, missing canonical ID replicated path, concurrency/conflicts, enqueue rollback, recovery, migration existing jobs, no resend. Additive DB changes only. q and affected tests then .27.6 acceptance.

comments.text: Implemented one owner: HistoryIngress.record_confirmation commits canonical content/reference, bounded receipt, evidence fingerprint and fixed transcript IDs in existing private message metadata atomically with ID-only job enqueue; capture_confirmed and worker share associate_confirmation. Existing TranscriptHistory capture pipeline extended with prepare mode; messages remain unplaced until association. Removed older independent capture_delivered/associate_execution_response writers. Worker only schedules/delegates; no transport sending or second lifecycle. Legacy queued payloads promote in place on processing; failed promotion leaves evidence retryable. No new table/migration. Regressions cover initial failing payload assertion, original UUID, unplaced preparation, concurrent duplicate confirmation, transactional rollback, connector disable/re-enable, immutable recipients after PersonChannel relinking, conflicts, job pruning, legacy conversion and property replay. Final mix q passed after one transient ExDNA timeout and local lint fixes; combined 12-file suite 477 tests +6 properties passes, diff check and reference audit clean. PR A acceptance .27.6 still open; B .8 must reuse this owner.

Latest user-approved audit supersedes legacy queued-payload promotion requirement from earlier comments: worker is absent on main and current enqueue produces only canonical message IDs. Removed promotion test, recover_legacy_confirmation, payload perform clause and alternate job-rewrite enqueue path. HistoryIngress remains the one atomic confirmation/fixed-target owner, with HistoryDeliveryWorker.enqueue called directly. Action reuse: local-only removal of unsupported WIP compatibility; no new operations/tools. Existing ID-only recovery/replay/rollback/UUID tests pass in affected suite and mix q passes. Engine docs and handoff updated. This is not outcome approval.

title: Unify reference-only history association recovery
